decision_question: Are three source-range-disjoint, question-deduplicated, gold-isolated development folds frozen for the finite architecture rounds?

hard_gates.name: public-hidden-gold-isolation
hard_gates.evidence: Every fold stores public cases and hidden gold separately with exact matching case-ID sets.

hard_gates.name: source-range-disjointness
hard_gates.evidence: Canonical source artifact, version, and character ranges have zero overlap between rounds.

hard_gates.name: question-deduplication
hard_gates.evidence: Normalized questions have zero within-fold or cross-fold duplicates after deterministic exclusion.

hard_gates.name: historical-datasets-immutable
hard_gates.evidence: The three source datasets remain unchanged; successor packages and excluded IDs are recorded separately.

hard_gates.name: provider-authority-closed
hard_gates.evidence: Dataset freezing made zero provider calls and incurred zero paid cost.

decision.rationale: Keep these folds for rounds 1–3 and proceed to architecture manifests and Round 1 without opening the fresh confirmation tranche.

limitations: The folds reuse the same four open educational source collections as earlier work, though their canonical ranges are pairwise disjoint.
This is dataset-construction evidence and makes no product-quality claim.
The one-time fresh 1,000-case confirmation tranche is not yet constructed or opened.
